en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdul Rahman Al Arzamy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There was between Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> a gap that of one cycle (six months and ten days), and the age gap between the two (Imams) was six months and ten (days)’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ‘Abd al-Rahman al-‘Arzami from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “
The time between the birth of al-Hassan and the conception for al-Husayn was like one menstuaral cycle and the time between the birth of the two was six months and tendays.”
